about.title: Electricians for Baytown homes and businesses
text: Fortress Electric works for homeowners and businesses in Baytown and the surrounding area, including Mont Belvieu, Atascocita and The Woodlands.
We take on installations and repairs, from panel upgrades, lighting and EV chargers to generators and troubleshooting.
Quality, reliability and safety guide every job we do.
